scope: Multi-order forward and inverse scenario investigation across all nine layers; six existing engines, not a seventh isolated engine.

distinctions.order: Number of explicit transmission steps from a declared shock in a versioned graph/model, relative to its resolution. An accounting or classification join is not a causal step. Multiple paths to one effect retain distinct path orders.
distinctions.time: Event, adoption, delay, observation and publication dates or intervals; independent of order.
distinctions.scenario: Coherent joint assumptions, initial conditions, interventions and boundary conditions; not a path order.
distinctions.evidence: Observed, conditional, hypothesized or causally identified; independent of order.

mandatory_dimensions: Higher-order effects O3 and beyond while material and supported
Distribution by actor, population, firm, sector and geography
Multiple interacting shocks and structural alternatives
scenario_families: Market expansion versus share transfers versus internalization
Adverse quality, financing, integration and supply stress
Policy, institutional and external shocks where relevant
stop_rules: Unsupported or blocked transmission: retain hypothesis and missing evidence; do not compute invented effect.
Outside declared scope, rights or materiality threshold: record justified exclusion and potential decision impact.
Budget or depth limit: mark truncated and retain frontier; never equate truncation with no effect.
Feedback cycles must be time-indexed or explicitly solved under a qualified simultaneous model; flag instability or nonconvergence.
Avoid counting the same effect across paths: calculate total as difference from a coherent counterfactual; only decompose interactions with a documented method and retain residual.
No probabilities without defensible calibration; no extrapolation of causal identification through unqualified links.
acceptance: Traceable O1/O2/O3+ paths where relevant, with coverage and stopped paths; no mandatory fabricated effects.
Null shock and no adoption tests; opposing scenarios and competing hypotheses; monotonicity only where justified.
Reconciled quantities and value flows under multi-path, interactions, capacity and feedback.
Time horizon distinct from order; delayed and simultaneous effects labeled.
Reverse investigation proposes competing mechanisms and discriminating tests, not reverse causality.
Scenario tree and comparison across orders, thresholds and actors in D12/D13/D15/D16/D17; alerts link to predicted or hypothesized signatures and revisions.
Reproducible pinned inputs, model, scenario and rights; benchmark methods under BENCH-001; no scientific or product gate promoted solely from this specification.
